verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs explicitly describe the typing-and-deduping engine that maps each stream one-to-one to a destination table ('No more sub-tables') producing typed, deduplicated tables rather than raw JSON, plus schema-change management and CDC support to keep those tables current. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that typing-deduping works reliably in production across destinations, and destination-specific coverage details.
